intro.en: A reading passage about taking healthy breaks. Islam allows lawful fun, as the Prophet ﷺ joked but said only the truth. The passage also says fun must not become mockery or waste of time.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek parhne ka matn hai jo jaiz tafreeh ke baare mein hai. Islam jaiz khel aur dil-lagi ki ijazat deta hai; Nabi ﷺ mazaq karte the lekin sirf sach kehte the. Magar tafreeh waqt ki barbadi ya kisi ka mazaq udaane ka zariya na bane.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الِاسْتِراحَةِ المُفيدَةِ: يُجيزُ الإِسْلامُ اللَّهْوَ المُباحَ، فَقَدْ كانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَمْزَحُ وَلا يَقولُ إِلّا حَقّاً. وَيُبَيِّنُ النَّصُّ أَنَّ التَّرْويحَ لا يَصيرُ سُخْرِيَةً وَلا إِضاعَةً لِلْوَقْتِ.

dialogue.ar: كَما يَتْعَبُ البَدَنُ مِنَ الحَرَكَةِ الطَّويلَةِ، تَتْعَبُ النَّفْسُ مِنَ الجِدِّ المُسْتَمِرِّ وَالعَمَلِ الدّائِم.
dialogue.tr: kamā yatʿabu l-badanu mina l-ḥarakati ṭ-ṭawīlat, tatʿabu n-nafsu mina l-jiddi l-mustamirri wa l-ʿamali d-dāʾim.
dialogue.en: As the body tires from long movement, the soul tires from constant seriousness and ceaseless work.
dialogue.ur: Jis tarah jism lambi harkat se thak jata hai, usi tarah nafs musalsal sanjeedgi aur lagataar kaam se thak jati hai.

dialogue.ar: لِذٰلِكَ يَسْمَحُ الإِسْلامُ لِلْمُجْتَهِدِ في عَمَلِهِ أَوْ دِراسَتِهِ أَنْ يُرَوِّحَ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِلَهْوٍ مُباحٍ.
dialogue.tr: li-dhālika yasmaḥu l-islāmu li-l-mujtahidi fī ʿamalihi aw dirāsatihi an yurawwiḥa ʿan nafsihi bi-lahwin mubāḥ.
dialogue.en: So Islam permits the one who strives in his work or study to relax with lawful fun.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye Islam apne kaam ya parhai mein mehnat karne wale ko jaiz tafreeh se dil behlane ki ijazat deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي سيرَةِ نَبِيِّنا ﷺ أُسْوَةٌ لَنا؛ فَقَدْ كانَ يَبْتَسِمُ لِأَصْحابِهِ وَيَمْزَحُ مَعَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa fī sīrati nabiyyinā ﷺ uswatun lanā; fa-qad kāna yabtasimu li-aṣḥābihi wa yamzaḥu maʿahum.
dialogue.en: We have a good example in the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: he used to smile at his companions and joke with them.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ mein hamare liye behtareen namoona hai: woh apne sahaba ko dekh kar muskurate aur un se mazaq farmate the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ يَقولُ لَهُمْ إِذا مَزَحَ: «إِنّي لا أَقولُ إِلّا حَقّاً».
dialogue.tr: wa kāna yaqūlu lahum idhā mazaḥ: «innī lā aqūlu illā ḥaqqn.»
dialogue.en: And when he joked he would say to them: «I say nothing but the truth.»
dialogue.ur: Aur jab mazaq karte to un se farmate: «Main sach ke siwa kuch nahi kehta.»

dialogue.ar: وَاللَّهْوُ المُباحُ كَثيرٌ: رِياضَةٌ تُقَوّي الأَبْدانَ، وَنُزْهَةٌ في الطَّبيعَةِ، وَحَديثٌ لَطيفٌ مَعَ الأَهْلِ وَالأَصْدِقاء.
dialogue.tr: wa l-lahwu l-mubāḥu kathīr: riīḍatun tuqawwī l-abdān, wa nuzhatun fī ṭ-ṭabīʿat, wa ḥadīthun laṭīfun maʿa l-ahli wa l-aṣdiqāʾ.
dialogue.en: Lawful fun is plentiful: sport that strengthens bodies, an outing in nature, and a pleasant chat with family and friends.
dialogue.ur: Jaiz tafreeh bohat hai: aisi warzish jo jismon ko mazboot kare, qudrat ke beech sair, aur ghar walon aur doston ke saath khush-guwar baat-cheet.

dialogue.ar: وَهٰذِهِ الأَنْشِطَةُ تَزيدُ نَشاطَنا وَتَجْعَلُ لِلْعَمَلِ بَعْدَها فائِدَةً أَكْبَر.
dialogue.tr: wa hādhihi l-anshiṭatu tazīdu nashāṭanā wa tajʿalu li-l-ʿamali baʿdahā fāʾidatan akbar.
dialogue.en: These activities increase our energy and make the work after them more beneficial.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sargarmiyan hamari chust-dasti barhati hain aur is ke baad ke kaam ko zyada nafa bakhsh bana deti hain.

dialogue.ar: لٰكِنْ لا يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَتَحَوَّلَ التَّرْويحُ إِلى سُخْرِيَةٍ مِنَ الآخَرينَ، فَالمَزْحُ الجَميلُ لا يَجْرَحُ أَحَداً.
dialogue.tr: lākin lā yanbaghī an yataḥawwala t-tarūīḥu ilā sukhriyatin mina l-ʾākharīn, fa-l-mazḥu l-jamīlu lā yajraḥu aḥadn.
dialogue.en: But relaxation should not turn into mockery of others; nice joking hurts no one.
dialogue.ur: Lekin tafreeh ko doosron ka mazaq udane mein nahi badalna chahiye; achha mazaq kisi ko zakhmi nahi karta.

dialogue.ar: وَلا يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَصيرَ اللَّهْوُ عُنْصُراً أَساسِيّاً في حَياتِنا، فَالحَياةُ أَثْمَنُ مِنْ أَنْ نُضَيِّعَها في اللَّعِب.
dialogue.tr: wa lā yanbaghī an yaṣīra l-lahwu ʿunṣurn asāsiyyn fī ḥayātinā, fa-l-ḥayātu athmanu min an nuḍayyiʿahā fī l-laʿib.
dialogue.en: Fun should not become a basic element of our lives, for life is too precious to waste in play.
dialogue.ur: Tafreeh hamari zindagi ka bunyadi hissa nahi banni chahiye, kyunke zindagi khel mein zaya karne se zyada qeemti hai.

dialogue.ar: فَلْيَكُنْ لِلتَّرْويحِ قَدْرٌ قَليلٌ مِنَ الوَقْتِ، وَلْيَكُنْ لِلْعِلْمِ وَالعَمَلِ الجُزْءُ الأَكْبَر.
dialogue.tr: fa-lyakun li-t-tarūīḥi qadrun qalīlun mina l-waqt, wa lyakun li-l-ʿilmi wa l-ʿamali l-juzʾu l-akbar.
dialogue.en: Let relaxation have a small measure of time, and let knowledge and work have the larger part.
dialogue.ur: Tafreeh ke liye waqt ki thori miqdar ho aur ilm aur kaam ke liye bara hissa.

dialogue.ar: وَالمُسْلِمُ الحَكيمُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الجِدِّ وَالتَّرْويحِ، وَيَحْفَظُ في الحالَتَيْنِ خُلُقَهُ وَدينَه.
dialogue.tr: wa l-muslimu l-ḥakīmu yajmaʿu bayna l-jiddi wa t-tarūīḥ, wa yaḥfaẓu fī l-ḥālatayni khuluqahu wa dīnah.
dialogue.en: The wise Muslim combines seriousness and relaxation, and in both cases keeps his character and his religion.
dialogue.ur: Samajhdar musalman sanjeedgi aur tafreeh ko jama karta hai, aur dono haalaton mein apne akhlaq aur deen ki hifazat karta hai.

q.en: According to the passage, what did the Prophet ﷺ say when he joked?
q.ur: Mazaq karte waqt Nabi ﷺ ne kya farmaya?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ، ماذا قالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ حينَ مَزَحَ؟

q.en: Why should relaxation take only a little time?
q.ur: Tafreeh thodi der kyun honi chahiye?
q.ar: لِماذا يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَكونَ التَّرْويحُ قَليلَ الوَقْتِ؟

options: Because life is too precious to waste / Kyunke zindagi zaya karne se qeemti hai
Because work is forbidden / Kyunke kaam mana hai
Because fun is forbidden / Kyunke tafreeh haraam hai
Because the soul never tires / Kyunke nafs kabhi nahi thakti
options_ar: لِأَنَّ الحَياةَ أَثْمَنُ مِنْ أَنْ تُضَيَّعَ

q.en: What is the plural of «بَدَن» (body) in the exercise?

title.en: Grammar: Nouns of time and place

intro.en: An ism zamān or ism makān names the time or place of an action. From a three-letter verb it comes on the pattern مَفْعِل or مَفْعَل: مَطْلِع (place/time of rising), مَهْبِط (place of descent), مَوْلِد (birthplace/time). Also مَفْعَلَة: مَدْرَسَة, مَكْتَبَة, مَقْبَرَة. Beyond three letters it looks like the passive participle: مُجْتَمَع, مُلْتَقى, مُسْتَوْدَع.
intro.ur: Ism-e-zamaan waqt aur ism-e-makaan jagah batata hai. Teen harfi fe'l se yeh wazan مَفْعِل ya مَفْعَل par aata hai, jaise مَطْلِع (nikalne ki jagah/waqt), مَهْبِط (utarne ki jagah), مَوْلِد (paida hone ki jagah/waqt). Aur مَفْعَلَة jaise مَدْرَسَة, مَكْتَبَة, مَقْبَرَة. Teen se zyada harfon wale fe'l se yeh ism-e-maf'ool jaisa banta hai: مُجْتَمَع, مُلْتَقى, مُسْتَوْدَع.
intro.ar: اسْما الزَّمانِ وَالمَكانِ يَدُلّانِ عَلى وَقْتِ الفِعْلِ أَوْ مَكانِهِ. يُصاغانِ مِنَ الفِعْلِ الثُّلاثِيِّ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعِل أَوْ مَفْعَل مِثْلَ مَطْلِع وَمَهْبِط وَمَوْلِد، وَعَلى مَفْعَلَة مِثْلَ مَدْرَسَة وَمَكْتَبَة وَمَقْبَرَة. وَمِنْ غَيْرِ الثُّلاثِيِّ يَأْتِيانِ عَلى صورَةِ اسْمِ المَفْعولِ مِثْلَ مُجْتَمَع وَمُلْتَقى.

vocab.ur: paida hone ki jagah ya waqt

q.en: Which word is a noun of place on the pattern مَفْعَلَة?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz مَفْعَلَة wazan par ism-e-makaan hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ مَكانٍ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعَلَة؟

options: Birthplace/time of the Messenger / Rasool ki paidaish ki jagah ya waqt
Death of the Messenger / Rasool ki wafat
Home of the Messenger / Rasool ka ghar
School of the Messenger / Rasool ka school
Place/time of sunrise / Suraj nikalne ki jagah ya waqt

q.en: Which is a noun of place from a verb with more than three letters?
q.ur: Teen se zyada harfon wale fe'l se ism-e-makaan kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ مَكانٍ مِنْ فِعْلٍ يَزيدُ عَلى ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ؟

intro.en: Practice spotting time and place nouns in sentences and in Quranic phrases, and give their pattern. Example: مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ (place of sunset) is a noun of place on the pattern مَفْعِل; مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ (time of dawn) is a noun of time on the pattern مَفْعَل.
intro.ur: Jumlon aur Quran ke alfaz mein ism-e-zamaan aur ism-e-makaan pehchanne ki mashq. Misaal: مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ (suraj ke doobne ki jagah) ism-e-makaan hai, wazan مَفْعِل; مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ (fajr ka waqt) ism-e-zamaan hai, wazan مَفْعَل.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى اسْتِخْراجِ اسْمَيِ الزَّمانِ وَالمَكانِ مِنَ الجُمَلِ وَالعِباراتِ القُرْآنِيَّةِ وَتَحْديدِ وَزْنِهِما. مِثالٌ: «مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ» اسْمُ مَكانٍ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعِل، وَ«مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ» اسْمُ زَمانٍ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعَل.

q.ur: «مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ» kis qism ka ism hai?
«مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ» kis qism ka ism hai?

options: Meeting place of the people / Logon ke milne ki jagah
Leader of the people / Qaum ka sardar
Home of the people / Qaum ka ghar
Food of the people / Qaum ka khana

intro.en: This lesson gives an example of a dialogue from the Quran: the story of two men and the garden, from Surat al-Kahf (verses 32 to 44), where a believer and a boastful friend talk to each other. It shows how a dialogue is built: each speaker answers the other.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Quran se guftagu ki misaal hai: do aadmiyon aur baagh ka qissa, Surah al-Kahf (aayat 32 se 44), jis mein ek momin aur ghamand karne wala saathi baat karte hain. Isse pata chalta hai ke guftagu mein har bolne wala doosre ko jawab deta hai.
intro.ar: يَعْرِضُ هٰذا الدَّرْسُ نَموذَجاً لِلْحِوارِ في القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ: قِصَّةُ صاحِبِ الجَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ سورَةِ الكَهْفِ (الآياتُ ٣٢ إِلى ٤٤) حَيْثُ يَتَحاوَرُ مُؤْمِنٌ وَصاحِبٌ مُتَكَبِّرٌ. وَيُبَيِّنُ كَيْفَ يُبْنى الحِوارُ: يَرُدُّ كُلُّ مُتَكَلِّمٍ عَلى الآخَرِ.

options: He talks with him / Woh us se guftagu karta hai
He runs from him / Woh us se bhaagta hai
He helps him / Woh uski madad karta hai
He teaches him / Woh use sikhata hai

q.en: What did Allah make for one of the two men?
q.ur: Allah ne un do aadmiyon mein se ek ke liye kya banaya?

q.en: A conversation between two people is called:
q.ur: Do logon ki baat cheet ko kehte hain:
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الحَديثِ المُتَبادَلِ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ؟

intro.en: Ism at-tafdīl compares two things, on the pattern أَفْعَل: مُحَمَّدٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ عَلِيّ (Muhammad is older than Ali). Use مِنْ before the thing compared. With «ال» it becomes the superlative: الأَكْبَر (the oldest), and it agrees with the noun in number and gender (الكُبْرى for a woman). خَيْر and شَرّ also work as comparatives.
intro.ur: Ism-e-tafdeel do cheezon ka muqabla karta hai, wazan أَفْعَل: مُحَمَّدٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ عَلِيّ (Muhammad Ali se bada hai). Jis se muqabla ho us se pehle مِنْ aata hai. «ال» ke saath yeh sab se zyada ka matlab deta hai: الأَكْبَر (sab se bada) aur noun ke mutabiq muzakkar/muannas aur wahid/jam' badalta hai (aurat ke liye الكُبْرى). خَيْر aur شَرّ bhi tafdeel ke tor par aate hain.
intro.ar: اسْمُ التَّفْضيلِ يُقارِنُ بَيْنَ شَيْئَيْنِ وَهُوَ عَلى وَزْنِ أَفْعَل: مُحَمَّدٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ عَلِيّ. وَنَأْتي بِـ«مِنْ» قَبْلَ المُفَضَّلِ عَلَيْهِ. وَإِذا دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ «ال» صارَ لِلتَّفْضيلِ المُطْلَقِ مِثْلَ الأَكْبَر، وَيُطابِقُ المَوْصوفَ في العَدَدِ وَالنَّوْعِ (الكُبْرى لِلْمُؤَنَّثِ). وَكَلِمَتا خَيْر وَشَرّ تُسْتَعْمَلانِ لِلتَّفْضيلِ أَيْضاً.

dialogue.ar: الجَبَلُ أَعْلى مِنَ التَّلِّ.
dialogue.tr: al-jabalu aʿlā mina t-tall.
dialogue.en: The mountain is higher than the hill.
dialogue.ur: Pahaad teelay se ooncha hai.

dialogue.ar: الصَّبْرُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الغَضَبِ.
dialogue.tr: aṣ-ṣabru khayrun mina l-ghaḍab.
dialogue.en: Patience is better than anger.
dialogue.ur: Sabr ghusse se behtar hai.

dialogue.ar: خالِدٌ أَطْوَلُ مِنْ أَخيهِ.
dialogue.tr: khālidun aṭwalu min akhīh.
dialogue.en: Khalid is taller than his brother.
dialogue.ur: Khalid apne bhai se lamba hai.

dialogue.ar: الأُمُّ أَرْحَمُ النّاسِ بِأَوْلادِها.
dialogue.tr: al-ummu arḥamu n-nāsi bi-awlādihā.
dialogue.en: The mother is the most merciful of people to her children.
dialogue.ur: Maa apni aulaad par sab logon se zyada reham karne wali hai.

dialogue.ar: الكِتابُ الأَصْغَرُ جَميلٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-kitābu l-aṣgharu jamīl.
dialogue.en: The smallest book is beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Sab se chhoti kitab khoobsurat hai.

dialogue.ar: المَدينَةُ الكُبْرى مُزْدَحِمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-madīnatu l-kubrā muzdaḥimat.
dialogue.en: The biggest city is crowded.
dialogue.ur: Sab se bara shehar bhara hua hai.

dialogue.ar: لَيْلى أَفْصَحُ مُتَحَدِّثَةٍ في المَدْرَسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: laylā afṣaḥu mutaḥaddithatin fī l-madrasat.
dialogue.en: Layla is the most eloquent speaker in the school.
dialogue.ur: Layla school ki sab se fasih bolne wali hai.

q.ur: "Bada" (muqabla) ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ تَفْضيلٍ بِمَعْنى «أَكْثَرُ كِبَراً»؟

q.en: Which word comes before the thing compared?
q.ur: Jis cheez se muqabla ho us se pehle kaun sa harf aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يَأْتي قَبْلَ المُفَضَّلِ عَلَيْهِ؟

options: Patience is better than anger / Sabr ghusse se behtar hai
Anger is better than patience / Ghussa sabr se behtar hai
Patience is small / Sabr chhota hai
Anger is patience / Ghussa sabr hai

q.en: What is the pattern of the comparative?

intro.en: A short historical scene about the caliph Abu Bakr when he is ill. 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn 'Awf visits him, and Abu Bakr consults him about who should lead the Muslims after him. The scene shows sincere advice, humility and fear of Allah. Then come exercises on useful expressions such as سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً and حُبّاً وَكَرامَةً.
intro.ur: Ek mukhtasar tareekhi manzar: Khalifa Abu Bakr bimar hain, Abdur Rahman bin Auf unki iyadat ko aate hain aur Abu Bakr un se mashwara karte hain ke unke baad musalmanon ki qiyadat kaun sambhale. Manzar khair-khwahi, aajzi aur khauf-e-Khuda dikhata hai. Phir mufeed alfaz jaise سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً aur حُبّاً وَكَرامَةً par mashqein hain.
intro.ar: مَشْهَدٌ تاريخِيٌّ قَصيرٌ: أَبو بَكْرٍ الخَليفَةُ مَريضٌ، وَيَزورُهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمٰنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ فَيَسْتَشيرُهُ فيمَنْ يَقومُ بِأَمْرِ المُسْلِمينَ بَعْدَهُ. يُظْهِرُ المَشْهَدُ النُّصْحَ الصّادِقَ وَالتَّواضُعَ وَخَشْيَةَ اللهِ. ثُمَّ تَمارين عَلى عِباراتٍ مُفيدَةٍ مِثْلَ سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً وَحُبّاً وَكَرامَةً.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يا أَبا بَكْرٍ، كَيْفَ حالُ الخَليفَةِ اليَوْمَ؟
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalayka yā abā bakr, kayfa ḥālu l-khalīfati l-yawm?
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, Abu Bakr; how is the caliph today?
dialogue.ur: Assalamu alaikum Abu Bakr, aaj khalifa ka kya haal hai?

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يا أَبا مُحَمَّدٍ. لَقَدِ افْتَقَدْتُكَ أَيّاماً، فَأَيْنَ كُنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalayka s-salāmu yā abā muḥammad. laqadi ftaqadtuka ayyāmn, fa-ayna kunt?
dialogue.en: And upon you peace, Abu Muhammad. I have missed you for days, so where were you?
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam Abu Muhammad. Maine aap ko kai din yaad kiya, aap kahan the?

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً يا خَليفَةَ المُسْلِمينَ؛ وَصَلَتْ قافِلَةٌ مِنَ الشّامِ، فَشَغَلَتْني التِّجارَةُ عَنْ زِيارَتِكَ.
dialogue.tr: ʿafūn yā khalīfata l-muslimīn; wa ṣalat qāfilatun mina sh-shām, fa-shaghalatnī t-tijāratu ʿan ziīratik.
dialogue.en: Forgive me, caliph of the Muslims; a caravan arrived from Sham, and trade kept me from visiting you.
dialogue.ur: Maaf kijiye Khalifa-e-Muslimeen; Sham se ek qafila aaya aur tijarat ne mujhe aap ki ziyarat se rok diya.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ بِعْتَ ما فيها؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal biʿta mā fīhā?
dialogue.en: And did you sell what was in it?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aap ne us mein jo tha bech diya?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، بِعْتُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِحَمْدِ اللهِ وَرَبِحْتُ رِبْحاً حَسَناً. وَكَيْفَ صِحَّتُكَ؟
dialogue.tr: naʿam, biʿtu kulla shayʾin bi-ḥamdi llāhi wa rabiḥtu ribḥn ḥasann. wa kayfa ṣiḥḥatuk?
dialogue.en: Yes, I sold everything, praise be to Allah, and made a good profit. And how is your health?
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, Allah ka shukr maine sab kuch bech diya aur achha nafa kamaya. Aur aap ki sehat kaisi hai?

dialogue.ar: ما زِلْتُ أُعاني مِنْ وَعْكَةٍ، وَلٰكِنَّ بارِئي سُبْحانَهُ أَرْحَمُ بي مِنْ نَفْسي.
dialogue.tr: mā ziltu uʿānī min wa ʿkat, wa lākinna bāriʾī subḥānahu arḥamu bī min nafsī.
dialogue.en: I still suffer from an illness, but my Creator, glory to Him, is more merciful to me than myself.
dialogue.ur: Abhi tak mujhe bukhar jaisi takleef hai, magar mera Khaliq, wo paak hai, mujh par mere apne aap se zyada mehrban hai.

dialogue.ar: شَفاكَ اللهُ يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ. هَلْ لَكَ حاجَةٌ عِنْدي؟
dialogue.tr: shafāka llāhu yā khalīfata rasūli llāh. hal laka ḥājatun ʿindī?
dialogue.en: May Allah heal you, successor of the Messenger of Allah. Do you need anything from me?
dialogue.ur: Allah aap ko shifa de, Khalifa-e-Rasoolullah. Kya aap ko mujh se koi haajat hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أُريدُ أَنْ أَسْتَشيرَكَ في أَمْرِ المُسْلِمينَ بَعْدي؛ فَمَنْ تَرى أَنْ أَسْتَخْلِفَ؟
dialogue.tr: naʿam, urīdu an astashīraka fī amri l-muslimīna baʿdī; fa-man tarā an astakhlif?
dialogue.en: Yes, I want to consult you about the affairs of the Muslims after me: whom do you think I should appoint as successor?
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main apke baad musalmanon ke maamle mein mashwara chahta hoon: aap ke khayal mein main kise apna jaanasheen banaon?

dialogue.ar: حُبّاً وَكَرامَةً. وَلٰكِنْ رُوَيْدَكَ يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ؛ فَالأَمْرُ يَحْتاجُ إِلى هُدوءٍ وَتَفْكير.
dialogue.tr: ḥubbn wa karāmatan. wa lākin ruwaydaka yā khalīfata rasūli llāh; fa-l-amru yaḥtāju ilā hudūʾin wa tafkīr.
dialogue.en: With love and honour. But take it easy, successor of the Messenger of Allah; the matter needs calm and thought.
dialogue.ur: Khushi se aur izzat ke saath. Magar zara thahriye Khalifa-e-Rasoolullah; yeh maamla sukoon aur ghaur-o-fikr chahta hai.

dialogue.ar: قُلْ ما عِنْدَكَ، فَإِنَّ الخَليفَةَ يَحْتاجُ إِلى النُّصْحِ الصّادِق.
dialogue.tr: qul mā ʿindak, fa-inna l-khalīfata yaḥtāju ilā n-nuṣḥi ṣ-ṣādiq.
dialogue.en: Say what you have; the caliph needs sincere advice.
dialogue.ur: Jo aap ke paas hai kahiye, kyunke khalifa ko sachchi nasihat ki zaroorat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: أَراكَ تُريدُ رَجُلاً قَوِيّاً أَميناً، وَلا أَعْلَمُ أَحَداً أَقْرَبَ إِلى ذٰلِكَ مِنْ عُمَرَ.
dialogue.tr: arāka turīdu rajuln qawiyyn amīnn, wa lā aʿlamu aḥadn aqraba ilā dhālika min ʿumar.
dialogue.en: I see you want a strong, trustworthy man, and I know no one closer to that than 'Umar.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe lagta hai aap taqatwar aur ameen aadmi chahte hain, aur main Umar se zyada is ke qareeb kisi ko nahi jaanta.

dialogue.ar: وَما قَوْلُكَ في شِدَّتِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mā qawluka fī shiddatih?
dialogue.en: And what do you say about his sternness?
dialogue.ur: Aur un ki sakhti ke baare mein aap kya kehte hain?

dialogue.ar: هِيَ شِدَّةٌ في الحَقِّ، وَقَلْبُهُ أَرَقُّ مِمّا يَظُنُّ النّاسُ، وَلٰكِنَّهُ يَحْتاجُ إِلى مَنْ يُذَكِّرُهُ بِالرِّفْق.
dialogue.tr: hiya shiddatun fī l-ḥaqq, wa qalbuhu araqqu mimmā yaẓunnu n-nās, wa lākinnahu yaḥtāju ilā man yudhakkiruhu bi-r-rifq.
dialogue.en: It is sternness in the truth, and his heart is gentler than people think, but he needs someone to remind him of kindness.
dialogue.ur: Woh haq mein sakhti hai, aur un ka dil logon ke khayal se zyada naram hai, magar unhein aise shakhs ki zaroorat hai jo narmi yaad dilaye.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الشِّدَّةَ الَّتي تَراها فيهِ كانَتْ لِأَنَّهُ رَآني لَيِّناً، فَإِذا صارَ الأَمْرُ إِلَيْهِ تَرَكَ كَثيراً مِنْها.
dialogue.tr: inna sh-shiddata l-tī tarāhā fīhi kānat li-annahu raʾānī layyinn, fa-idhā ṣāra l-amru ilayhi taraka kathīrn minhā.
dialogue.en: The sternness you see in him was because he saw me gentle; if the matter passes to him he will leave much of it.
dialogue.ur: Jo sakhti aap un mein dekhte hain woh is liye thi ke unhon ne mujhe narm dekha, jab maamla un ke paas aayega to bohat si chhor denge.

dialogue.ar: ما أَثْقَلَ هٰذِهِ الأَمانَةَ يا أَبا بَكْر!
dialogue.tr: mā athqala hādhihi l-amānata yā abā bakr!
dialogue.en: How heavy this trust is, Abu Bakr!
dialogue.ur: Yeh amanat kitni bhaari hai Abu Bakr!

dialogue.ar: وَيْحَكَ، إِنَّها أَمانَةٌ فِعْلاً، وَسَيُسْأَلُ كُلُّ راعٍ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ يَوْمَ القِيامَةِ، وَالحِسابُ عَسير.
dialogue.tr: wa yḥak, innahā amānatun fiʿln, wa sayusʾalu kullu rāʿin ʿan raʿiyyatihi yawma l-qiīmat, wa l-ḥisābu ʿasīr.
dialogue.en: Woe to you, it is truly a trust, and every shepherd will be asked about his flock on the Day of Resurrection, and the reckoning is hard.
dialogue.ur: Arre bhai, yeh waaqai amanat hai, aur qayamat ke din har nigehbaan se uski raiyat ka sawal hoga, aur hisaab sakht hai.

dialogue.ar: سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً لِما تَراهُ يا أَبا بَكْرٍ؛ فَإِذا اخْتَرْتَ الأَصْلَحَ فَهٰذِهِ العَقَبَةُ الكُبْرى قَدْ زالَتْ.
dialogue.tr: samʿn wa ṭāʿatan limā tarāhu yā abā bakr; fa-idhā khtarta l-aṣlaḥa fa-hādhihi l-ʿaqabatu l-kubrā qad zālat.
dialogue.en: We hear and obey what you see fit, Abu Bakr; if you choose the most suitable man, this great obstacle has gone.
dialogue.ur: Jo aap munasib samjhen hum ne suna aur maana Abu Bakr; agar aap behtareen shakhs chun len to yeh bari rukawat door ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: سَأَسْتَشيرُ غَيْرَكَ مِنْ كِبارِ الصَّحابَةِ ثُمَّ أَكْتُبُ عَهْدي، وَأَسْأَلُ اللهَ أَنْ يُوَفِّقَني.
dialogue.tr: saʾastashīru ghayraka min kibāri ṣ-ṣaḥābati thumma aktubu ʿahdī, wa asʾalu llāha an yuwaffiqanī.
dialogue.en: I will consult others of the senior companions, then write my covenant, and I ask Allah to grant me success.
dialogue.ur: Main aap ke ilawa bare sahaba se bhi mashwara karunga phir apna ahd likhunga, aur Allah se tofeeq maangta hoon.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً؛ فَما بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَمْرٌ هَيِّنٌ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: jazāka llāhu khayrn; fa-mā baʿda dhālika amrun hayyinun bi-idhni llāh.
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you well; what comes after that is an easy matter, by Allah's leave.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap ko jaza-e-khair de; us ke baad ka maamla Allah ke hukm se aasaan hai.

vocab.ur: afsos hai tujh par (narmi se tambeeh)

q.en: Whom did 'Abd ar-Rahman say was closest to being strong and trustworthy?
q.ur: Abdur Rahman ke mutabiq taqatwar aur ameen hone ke sab se qareeb kaun tha?
q.ar: مَنْ كانَ أَقْرَبَ إِلى صِفَةِ القَوِيِّ الأَمينِ في رَأْيِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمٰنِ؟

q.en: What did Abu Bakr want in a leader?
q.ur: Abu Bakr leader mein kya chahte the?
q.ar: ماذا أَرادَ أَبو بَكْرٍ في القائِدِ؟

options: The strong and trustworthy / Taqatwar aur ameen
With love and honour / Khushi aur izzat ke saath
I refuse / Main inkar karta hoon
I do not know / Mujhe nahi pata

q.en: Why was 'Abd ar-Rahman away the previous days?
q.ur: Abdur Rahman pichle dino kyun gair haazir the?
q.ar: لِماذا غابَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمٰنِ في الأَيّامِ الماضِيَةِ؟

options: A trade caravan from Sham kept him busy / Sham se aaye tijarati qafile ki wajah se
He was ill / Woh bimar the
He travelled to Makkah / Woh Makkah gaye
He was sleeping / Woh so rahe the
We hear and obey / Hum ne suna aur maana
We ask and answer / Poochna aur jawab dena
We sit and wait / Baithna aur intezar
We read and write / Parhna aur likhna
